statusMeaning.coreImplementation: The verified V2 compiler, admission, serialization, attachment, revalidation and observation primitives exist as owner source.

byteIdentities.contents: Selected context items plus canonical typed context framing only.
byteIdentities.tokenization: Compiler budget accounting; not sufficient as final provider-request proof.

byteIdentities.contents: Typed role/content fragments derived from the canonical context bundle for request composition.
byteIdentities.tokenization: Diagnostic only until final provider request is constructed.

byteIdentities.contents: The exact logical request submitted to the provider adapter, including roles, tools, templates and provider framing under the registered model profile.
byteIdentities.tokenization: Must be counted by the registered real model tokenizer after final construction.

byteIdentities.contents: Canonical semantic digest of the actual provider wire attempt; transport-only nondeterminism is excluded by the provider contract.
byteIdentities.tokenization: Must reference the same logical final-request identity; it is not a substitute for the final-request tokenizer proof.
